snippet.title: "Untrusted: hackers at large" - Teaser trailer
snippet.description:
Official teaser trailer for "Untrusted: hackers at large", the single player prequel of "Untrusted: web of cybercrime".

Wishlist on Steam or try the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508150/

Join the discord server: http://discord.playuntrusted.com
